arguments.where_clause: transactions.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND transactions.amount_usd_cents > 20000 AND transactions.card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND u.credit_score < 650)
arguments.explanation: Flags online transactions over $200 made on credit cards whose owner has a credit score below 650.
assumptions: 'Credit cards' read as card_type = 'Credit' only, excluding 'Debit (Prepaid)' and 'Debit'.
Credit score below 650 read as users.credit_score < 650 (650 itself not included).
